source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Disable NTP function in OS
2. Adjust SUT time to match with a standard time
3. Shutdown SUT with power cord plugged
4. Idle SUT for at least 24 hours
5. Power on the SUT
6. Check SUT time

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. NTP should be disabled successfully
2. SUT time should be adjusted successfully
3. SUT time should not over or less than 1.73 seconds (1.73 seconds / 24 hours) after idle over 24 hrs

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- after the operator cuts and restores AC, reads /dev/rtc vs host clock over the idle dwell. Agent first disables NTP and reads the RTC via sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "timedatectl set-ntp false 2>&1; hwclock -r 2>&1; date -u 2>&1", then the 24h AC/reboot dwell (operator part for AC) elapses and the agent re-reads to compute drift. The ac_supplied_power_ dwell is the long-running/operator step.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL RTC (`hwclock -r`) vs system UTC (`date -u`) timestamps at start and after the dwell so the user computes the drift (<=1.73s/day tolerance).
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: disabling NTP + comparing RTC is a state change; restore NTP after the dwell, and the AC-cycle portion is a physical operator action.

original_test_intent: Measure SUT clock drift within 1.73 seconds over at least 24 hours while the SUT is shut down but remains supplied with AC, after NTP is disabled and time is aligned to a standard reference.
original_method: Approved automation captures clock state, disables NTP, aligns time, shuts down while retaining AC, waits at least 24 hours, powers on through an approved management interface, reads the clock, calculates drift and restores synchronization.
manual_activity: No physical AC operation is required or permitted by this source. A user supplies the approved reference, clock policy and unchanged test plan; human presence is not inherently required when shutdown and power-on are controllable through the approved management path.
required_inputs: Reference clock and synchronized start/end method
Timezone, OS clock versus RTC interpretation and BMC time role
AC-connected shutdown and remote power-on path with recovery
Script revision, 24-hour window, final state and one-user approval
safety_requirements: Do not cut AC; the source requires the power cord to remain plugged.
Approve time changes because they can affect logs, certificates, schedulers and distributed services.
Retain original NTP/time configuration and verify restoration after drift evidence is captured.
Stop on unexpected power loss, clock correction, boot failure or management loss; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Execute the approved clock baseline, NTP disable, time alignment, AC-connected shutdown, timed dwell, remote power-on and post-read sequence.
Calculate elapsed reference time and SUT drift against 1.73 seconds per 24 hours.
Collect full command, power, boot and log evidence and report the tool result separately from engineer verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve reference/time semantics, state changes, window and recovery.
Ensure AC remains present and no external action changes the condition.
Review evidence and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: timedatectl, hwclock and date are relevant after OS/version validation, but the commentary's AC cut/restore changes the test and must be rejected.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the validated repository script or approved equivalents while preserving AC-connected power-off; do not add an operator AC cycle.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: NTP disable, reference alignment, shutdown with cord plugged, at least 24 hours, 1.73 seconds/day and 10/1440-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: RETAIN SOURCE METHOD; CORRECT HISTORICAL AC MISREAD
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture monotonic/reference timestamps and RTC/OS/BMC state, run the unchanged AC-connected 24-hour shutdown plan, calculate signed drift explicitly, then restore and verify synchronization.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Target OS and BMC with approved clock and remote power controls.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record OS, kernel, systemd, util-linux, BMC and script revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Owner clock/RTC policy and repository script revision.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds clock-domain and restoration traceability; removes no source step and adds no AC removal.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No loss; it specifically preserves powered-off-with-AC RTC coverage.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Reference, clock modes, power path and restore policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Boot duration must not be confused with the 24-hour reference interval, and NTP must remain disabled until measurement completes.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve a longer dwell or alternate validated clock tools, with tolerance scaled only by an explicit plan. It may not replace AC-supplied power-off with AC removal while claiming this source case.
expected_evidence: Approved reference/timezone/RTC/NTP policy, power plan, script/tool versions and authorization
Pre-shutdown RTC/OS/BMC/reference timestamps and NTP-disable/time-set results
Proof AC remained supplied, shutdown/power-on timestamps, post-boot clocks and signed drift calculation
NTP restoration, boot/host health, unexpected-log review and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently specifies AC supplied during power-off and a 1.73-second/24-hour tolerance. The AC-cut statement exists only in the DeepSeek review, not in the source.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Reference and power-control details are readiness inputs. The complete source procedure is automatable once they are approved.

review_improvement: Restores the exact power condition and recognizes that a long dwell and user-supplied parameters do not themselves make the core test partial.
independent_technical_reasoning: Every core action—clock configuration, shutdown, timed wait, management power-on, timestamp capture, drift calculation and restoration—can be automated on a managed server. The absence of physical AC manipulation is decisive; readiness confirmation is not a manual core step.
